name: month
definition: Calendar month 1..12 of the requested delivery month

name: quarter
definition: Calendar quarter 1..4

name: days_in_month
definition: Days in the month

name: is_december / is_january
definition: Year-end flags (ordinary channel year-end pattern)

name: f_season
definition: Region x calendar-month x channel x calendar-month seasonality (+ Thermal x month), each profile averaging 1, estimated per origin by ratio of sums

name: lny_days_apac
definition: Days of the Lunar New Year window in the month (Asia Pacific); 2027-02: 10, 2028-01: 6, 2028-02: 4

name: ramadan_days_mea
definition: Days of Ramadan in the month (Middle East & Africa); 2027-02: 21, 2027-03: 9, 2028-01: 4, 2028-02: 26

name: f_holiday
definition: 1 - depth x days / window length (LNY 10 days, Ramadan 30 days); depths estimated per origin by Poisson MLE

name: lag_1
definition: Filled unconstrained demand 1 month(s) before, on the full grid with explicit gaps

name: lag_2
definition: Filled unconstrained demand 2 month(s) before, on the full grid with explicit gaps

name: lag_3
definition: Filled unconstrained demand 3 month(s) before, on the full grid with explicit gaps

name: lag_12
definition: Filled unconstrained demand 12 month(s) before, on the full grid with explicit gaps

name: roll_mean_3
definition: Trailing 3-month mean of filled unconstrained demand (months before t)

name: roll_mean_6
definition: Trailing 6-month mean of filled unconstrained demand (months before t)

name: roll_mean_12
definition: Trailing 12-month mean of filled unconstrained demand (months before t)

name: roll_std_3
definition: Trailing 3-month standard deviation of filled unconstrained demand

name: roll_std_6
definition: Trailing 6-month standard deviation of filled unconstrained demand

name: roll_std_12
definition: Trailing 12-month standard deviation of filled unconstrained demand

name: level_me_12
definition: Trailing 12-month monthly-equivalent level: sum of demand / latent months the orders carried (cycle-aware)

name: zero_share_12
definition: Share of zero months in the trailing 12 (scheduled off-months included)

name: ratio_level12 / ratio_level36 / ratio_level_all
definition: De-factored level over the last 12 / 36 months / all history relative to the 24-month level

name: resid3 / resid6 / resid12
definition: Recent in-sample residual ratio: demand / fitted expectation over the last 3 / 6 / 12 months

name: level
definition: Forecast level: ratio of sums of de-factored unconstrained demand over the last 24 months of level cells (arithmetic, mean-unbiased); credibility blend with the cross-sectional prior for series younger than 24 months; prior for cold starts

name: prior_level / ratio_prior
definition: Cross-sectional level prior: log-linear model on family, tier x region, channel and powertrain of mature series, smeared to the mean
source: series levels as of the origin

name: sbc_adi_36 / sbc_cv2_36 / sbc_class_36
definition: Syntetos-Boylan ADI, CV^2 and class (smooth / intermittent / erratic / lumpy; cut-offs 1.32 / 0.49) on the trailing 36 months; reporting only, the zeros are scheduled by the cycle

name: cycle_kind / accum_span / carry_weight
definition: Ordering-cycle regime (M / A / B / Q / T), latent months an order carries and the weight of carried months (0.5 after an annual shutdown)

name: macro_leadlag (family x indicator x lag 0..12 x era)
definition: Weighted correlation of the family macro index (de-seasonalised, de-levelled, EV removed) with each standardised indicator at lags 0..12, by era; is_driver = selected by forward selection in that era

name: family drivers
definition: Up to 3 indicators per family by forward selection (economic sign, chi-square gain >= 9) at their best lag 0..6, with a lag posterior from the deviance profile; refit at every origin

name: f_macro
definition: SKU macro multiplier exp(lm(t)) relative to its level-window mean; lm = soft-capped (slope 0.5 above 0.25) sum of SKU coefficients x indicators averaged over the SKU lag posterior; coefficients shrunk to the family (prior sd 0.06 per sd); 2021-01..2022-11 amplitude x0.9; Aftermarket = damping x path + Fuel at lag 1

name: macro_sensitivity
definition: Change in log latent demand per +1 unit of each indicator at each lag, per SKU and channel group

name: f_ev
definition: exp(beta_class x (EV index(t) - level-window mean)), zero lag, class level (EV / ICE; Universal 0), betas by Poisson MLE per origin

name: months_since_launch
definition: Months since the product launch (effective launch date; BSS-018 2025-02)

name: series_age
definition: Months since the series' first month (region age for the MEA opening cohort)

name: months_to_eol
definition: Months to the EOL date (negative after EOL)

name: f_lifecycle
definition: Launch ramp 1 - exp(-(k+1)/4.6) on product age (launches), 1 - exp(-(k+1)/6) on series age (MEA opening cohort), times the EOL phase-out 0.90 / 0.81 / 0.71 / 0.61 / 0.52 / 0.42 at 5..0 months to EOL; 0 after EOL

name: lifecycle_phase
definition: post_eol / lost_account / eol_phaseout / cold_start / just_launched / young / mature

name: f_event
definition: Helios Auto Parts India programme step (measured multiplier, half exposure in 2025-09) x Orion Driveline North America 2027-07/08 shutdown (measured Nexon 2023 strike multiplier, no catch-up), customer at time

name: event masks (history)
definition: COVID 2020-02..09, pre-buy T1 + AM 2022-12..2023-02, Nexon strike, Red Sea Export EU / MEA, one-offs, unknown targets: excluded from fitting (train_mask); semiconductor window, EOL phase-out and pre-switch months excluded from levels (level_mask)

name: one_offs12 / imputed12
definition: One-off orders and imputed cells in the last 12 months
